srp_prompt.review_scope: Review actual outputs and end-to-end journeys on representative repositories; agree a prioritized gap register and measurable Beta 1 acceptance denominator with the operator.
srp_prompt.review_instructions: Verify issue scope, explicit dependencies, actual evidence, candidate provenance, negative cases and proportional validation. Each observed case identifies repository revision, candidate components, scenario, expected/actual result and evidence. Each gap has reproduction, impact, priority, acceptance measure and existing follow-on mapping. Label unexercised paths honestly. Operator agrees corpus, measurable denominator and priorities; independent review checks evidence. Reject unreproduced defects and substitution of prior qualification for user acceptance.
srp_prompt.review_evidence_requirements: README.md; docs/codefriend/INSTALLED_CONTENT_JOURNEY.md; current representative report/export artifacts and journey evidence; runtime-dependencies and shared-library-dependencies authenticated manifests; ADL v0.93.2 CodeFriend feature contract; GitHub #120.; exact work-product revision, changed paths, VPP/SOR and retained native receipts.
srp_prompt.reviewer_constraints: Independent exact-head review before publication. Preparation review by Planning #12 is separate from later implementation review. No duplicate builds, paid calls or invented results.
srp_prompt.refusal_policy: Reject unsupported readiness, missing required behavior proof, false completion, scope expansion and unresolved actionable findings.
srp_prompt.follow_up_routing: Return preparation findings to Worker #29 under ADL #1299; implementation findings to the sole child owner; missing owner primitives remain explicit prerequisites.
